title: surveySystem document (flat node list)
description: A widget document as a flat list of nodes. Exactly one node has no parent (the root). Convert it to the tree, compile the Blueprint, and repair from its diagnostics.

nodes.description: Every widget of the document, parents before their children.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A Survey may go into: Survey.header.

config.description: How the survey is titled and where it is sent.

slots.description: Only needed to declare a slot that has no children; otherwise leave the key out. The slot names of this node, in order.

node_Survey.description: A survey: a header, the questions in order, and a footer note. The root of a survey document. It counts the answered questions through the `questions` contract. Slots: header (any widget): Anything shown above the questions.; questions (Rating, Choice): The questions, in order.; footer (Note): Closing notes shown under the questions.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A Rating may go into: Survey.header, Survey.questions.

scale.description: The highest value of the scale, from 3 to 10; the lowest is 1. 5 when left out. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

node_Rating.description: A rating question: pick a number on a scale. No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A Choice may go into: Survey.header, Survey.questions.

options.description: The options, in the order shown: at least two.

multiple.description: Whether more than one option may be chosen. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

followUp.description: A question shown once this one is answered. Must be the id of a widget of type Rating | Choice in the same document. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

node_Choice.description: A choice question: pick one or more options. No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A Note may go into: Survey.header, Survey.footer.

config.description: The text of the note. Leave the config out for an empty note. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

node_Note.description: A short text. No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: The option's identifier, unique within the question: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or hyphens (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`).

label.description: The label shown for the option.

type_ChoiceOption.description: One option of a choice question.

type_I18nText.description: Text per language, keyed by language tag (`en`, `zh-TW`). At least one language should be present; the renderer falls back to the first one. A dictionary: in this schema it is written as a list of { "key", "value" } entries with unique keys, for example [{ "key": "a", "value": ... }], not as an object. Where the text above shows the object form, write the entry list instead.

maxQuestions.description: The most questions the survey may hold: from 1 to 20; 10 when left out. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

submitUrl.description: Where the answers are sent: a URI. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

type_SurveyRawConfig.description: The raw config of a survey.
